narr: A line of thunderstorms moving along a stalled frontal boundary draped across the coastal waters produced heavy rainfall resulting in flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rainfall lead to a few roads near Kiln to become impassable.
Broadcast media reported road closures between Landon Road and Robinson Road in Lyman due to water covered roadways.
Heavy rain lead to several impassable roadways from Gautier to Moss Point.
